review:
Might of Freya Megaways puts the Norse goddess on a 6x7 grid with tumbling wins and a respin mechanic based on lives. The Freya Super Symbol acts as a wild that appears only on the bottom row under reels 2–5, and when it lands it awards respins with wilds carrying a random number of lives. Each respin after a tumble uses up a life, and respins end when no wilds remain.

A Redrop symbol can clear the reels and counts as a tumble, which may create new wins. The bonus is triggered by five consecutive tumble wins, and a wheel spin beforehand sets the number of free spins and the minimum number of ways. Pragmatic Play advertises wins of up to 8,000x. The RTP is 96.5%. The trigger rewards long cascades rather than scatter luck.
